parsing_protocol.outer_whitespace: ignored for envelope parsing only; evidence strings unchanged
accepted: one entire JSON code fence with no outside text
parsing_protocol.strict_format: only bare JSON is strict; a single full code fence remains a recorded format violation
parsing_protocol.evidence_type: string or null; preserve exactly, with no whitespace trimming or cleanup
parsing_protocol.invalid: non-stop, unparseable, wrong fields or types; never substitute a judgment
parsing_protocol.empty_evidence: null and the empty string count as empty only in evidence diagnostics
parsing_protocol.denominators: valid-only confusion metrics plus invalid counts by gold and all-record possible F1 bounds
